body: The values here are the bit patterns of the correctly rounded doubles, taken from the host's own parser, which is the only oracle for this question that is not the thing under test.

author: reek
body: The last three literals were already correct before the fix and are controls rather than padding: each has a short enough expansion that one division was the whole computation, so a change that broke the exact cases would be caught here rather than looking like an improvement everywhere.

author: reek
body: Bits, not a rendered decimal. A decimal render of a Real cannot express a one-ulp difference, which is the entire quantity under test.
